{{Quote|There aren't so many Togruta at large in the galaxy that I fit into a crowd. It would be different if I were a Twi'lek, and it would be very different if I were a human, but I'm neither.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="Ahsoka">[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']]</ref>}}
The '''Togruta''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]], characterized by their [[color]]ful skin tones, large [[montral]]s, [[Lekku|head tails]], and white facial pigments. They hailed from the [[planet]] [[Shili]], in the [[Expansion Region]]. Although Shili was their [[homeworld]], they also had a [[Artisan colony|colony]] of some 50,000 individuals on the planet [[Kiros]], also in the Expansion Region. Some well known Togruta included the [[Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti]], Jedi Master [[Jora Malli]], [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Kirames Kaj]], and [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:KirosTogruta-TCWs4BR2.png|thumb|left|200px|A male and female Togruta]]
Native to the [[Expansion Region]] [[planet]] [[Shili]] but later found throughout [[the galaxy]],<ref name="Togruta DB" /> the Togruta were a [[species]] of [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]]s whose skin spanned a vast array of [[color]]s, including, but not limited to, orange, red, white, and yellow.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> These characteristics were a result of evolution; Togruta coloration was helpful as a method of camouflage from predators.<ref name="LOTJ">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref>

Unlike most humanoids, Togrutas were known to have multiple [[stomach]]s.<ref name="Ahsoka" /> Their most notable features were the large organic head formations upon their heads: two large cone-like horns called [[montral]]s atop their [[Bone|skull]]; and three [[lekku]], also known as headtails, that sprouted downward. Both a Togruta's lekku and montrals tended to grow until they reached maturity, with [[Gender|females]] generally having longer lekku than the males. The male's montrals, however, were more branched than the females.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> The Togruta's montrals served as the auditory system and allowed them to sense the movement of objects around them through echolocation. Their echolocation evolved to aid them in hunting and was extremely powerful. They could sense up to 82 [[Foot|feet]] (25 [[meter]]s).<ref name="AbEverything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> Togrutas were also known to have 6 holes (3 on each side), right where the lekku met the jawline. The purpose of these external holes is unknown, but is implied to be ears based on their location.<ref name="Part Five: Shadow Warrior">{{Ahsoka|Part Five: Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Idiot. Do you think all Togruta know each other?|[[Neera]], to her brother [[Hoban]]|<ref name="Ahsoka" />}}
[[File:ShiliVillage-LaD.png|thumb|right|270px|A Togruta village on Shili]]
The Togruta's habitats were usually in [[mountain]]ous and elevated areas. One instance of this was the Togruta immigrants on the colonies on [[Kiros]], which were built on the cliffs. These homes were built in the pursuit of art and beauty.<ref name="VE" /> Togruta generally spoke both [[Galactic Basic Standard]]<ref name="TCW film" /> and their native [[language]], [[Togruti]].<ref name="Rising Storm" />

Members of the species, particularly those from Shili, were fiercely protective of their world and its surrounding moons, and they regarded the ground beneath their feet as sacred. Because of this, a number of Togruta would elect to remain barefoot, only wearing boots while off-world.<ref name="Rising Storm" />

A [[Togruta government|government]] of the Togruta was established on Shili, and could be led by a [[queen]]. A queen of the Togruta government on Shili was also bestowed the titles of [[Regasa]] of Shili, [[Supreme Huntress of the United Tribes]], and [[Ruler of Togrutas]]. The government consisted of the [[Togruta military]] and the [[Togruta guard]]. The [[Royal Togruta Fleet]] consisted of many [[Togruta warship]]s, and the military forces were additionally bolstered by the [[Togruta intelligence|intelligence services]] and the [[Togruta security council|security council]]. The Togruta maintained a [[Togruta royal court|royal court]], and the government employed the position of [[ambassador]] and multiple [[minister]]s.<ref name="Rising Storm" /> Conversely, the Togruta on the [[artisan colony]] on Kiros built their society without weapons, choosing instead to pursue art and beauty rather than war.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

Shili was known to produce famously melodramatic [[holovid]]s. One of the signs in Shili's zodiac system was called [[Ai]]. Its traits were wisdom, charisma, and exceptional virility. The constellation representing that sign was formed from [[blue dwarf]] [[star]]s, and a being [[Reproduction|born]] under Ai also had the sign [[Genry]] on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Leia">''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]''</ref>

==History==
===High Republic Era===
[[File:Togruta_Royal_Fleet_THR_SATF_2021.png|thumb|left|270px|The Royal Togruta Fleet arrive to bolster Republic defenses on Valo in 231 BBY]]
In [[382 BBY]]<ref name="382 BBY Date">''[[Star Wars: The High Republic Character Encyclopedia]]'' dates the events of [[The High Republic (2022) 1|''The High Republic'' (2022) 1]] to [[382 BBY]].</ref> during the [[High Republic Era]],<ref name="THR 1">[[The High Republic (2022) 1|''The High Republic'' (2022) 1]]</ref> the Togruta government were engaged in a [[Republic-Togruta conflict|conflict]] against the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Rising Storm" /> and [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="THR 1" /> By [[231 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> still during the High Republic, the Togruta on Shili were presided by the monarchial government led by [[Elarec Yovet]], the Togruta queen. By this [[time]], the Togruta were still not members of the Republic, and [[Jedi Master]] [[Stellan Gios]] believed that the only obstacle in the Togruta declaring an open conflict against the Republic was the Togruta's respect for the [[Jedi]].<ref name="Rising Storm" /> [[Jora Malli]] was a Togruta who was a Jedi Master, serving within the Order's [[Jedi High Council]], although she was [[Death|killed]] during the [[Battle of Kur]].<ref name="Light of the Jedi">''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]''</ref>

[[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Lina Soh]]'s achievements in diplomacy brought forward a [[Togruta delegation]], with Regasa Elarec Yovet, to visit the [[Republic Fair]] as part of Soh's [[Great Works]].<ref name="Rising Storm" /> In [[231 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> during the [[Nihil]] [[Valo Atrocity|attack on Valo]] during the Republic Fair, the Royal Togruta Fleet and military personnel responded to the crisis, bolstering Republic forces and driving back the Nihil. In the aftermath, Regasa Yovet sought to create an alliance with the Republic and potentially establish stronger ties, despite opposition in the Togruta government.<ref name="Rising Storm" />

===Fall of the Republic Era===
Eventually, in [[40 BBY]],<ref name="MA Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' places the events of ''[[Master & Apprentice]]'' in [[40 BBY]].</ref> the Togruta [[Kirames Kaj]] was the Supreme Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Master & Apprentice">''[[Master & Apprentice]]''</ref> Several Togruta were part of the Jedi Order in the time following the [[Invasion of Naboo]], including Jedi Master [[Shaak Ti]] and the [[Jedi Initiate]] [[Ashla (Jedi)|Ashla]].<ref name="Episode II" /> Shaak Ti was placed as the overseer of Republic [[clone trooper]] training on [[Kamino]].<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>

[[File:InvasionOfKiros-Kidnapped.png|thumb|right|300px|[[B1-series battle droid]]s round up Togruta citizens]]
During the [[Clone Wars]], the Togruta were brought at the forefront of the conflict with the [[conquest of Kiros]], [[battle on Kiros]]<ref name="Kidnapped" /> and subsequent [[Battle of Kadavo]].<ref name="Escape from Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref> These battles were effects from the [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]]'s efforts to expand [[slavery]] operations with the support of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Zygerrian]] and CIS forces occupied the neutral artisan colony on Kiros and enslaved the 50,000 Togruta inhabitants, including [[Governor]] [[Gupat Roshti]]. [[Grand Army of the Republic]] forces later arrived to the deserted Togruta settlement, destroying the [[Separatist Droid Army]] forces and defeating the Zygerrian [[commander]]. The [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] undertook a [[mission to Zygerria]] in an effort to locate the missing Togruta colonists.<ref name="Slaves">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

They were assisted by Skywalker's Togruta [[padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano]],<ref name="Slaves" /> who had taken part in many pivotal and climactic battles of the war including the [[Battle of Christophsis]],<ref name="TCW film" /> the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> and several other conflicts. Eventually locating the missing Togruta on the Zygerrian [[Kadavo slave processing facility|slave processing facility]], the Republic mounted an operation that liberated a number of the colonists. In the aftermath, Togruta Governor Roshti decided to join the Republic.<ref name="Escape from Kadavo" />

===Imperial Era===
[[File:AhsokaArtCropped.png|thumb|left|250px|The Togruta Ahsoka Tano (pictured) was a vital figure to the early rebellion.]]
Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] of the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]], Togruta [[Jedi]] were hunted down<ref name="Ahsoka" /> and killed.<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> With the rise of the Empire came the rise of resistance groups, including the [[Partisans]]<ref name="Rebel Rising">''[[Rebel Rising]]''</ref> and the [[Raada resistance|resistance group]] on [[Raada]]. Several Togruta were part of these groups, with Ahsoka Tano leading the Raada resistance and eventually joining the [[Bail Organa's resistance movement|resistance movement]] led by [[Alderaanian]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]].<ref name="Ahsoka" /> Eventually, Organa's movement joined with other rebel cells and networks to form the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="Dawn">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref> which was composed of many species including Togruta and fought in the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Blade Squadron">{{InsiderCite|160|Blade Squadron: Zero Hour}}</ref>

A Togruta was also part of [[Lady]] [[Qi'ra]]'s anti-Imperial [[Crimson Dawn]] movement, listening to her speech rallying the gathered members of the [[Dawn Fleet]] ahead of the [[Battle at Amaxine Station]]. The [[fleet]] engaged with<ref name="Hidden Empire 4">[[Hidden Empire 4|''Hidden Empire'' 4]]</ref> a fleet of [[Star Destroyer]]s<ref name="Aphra (2020) 30">[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 30|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 30]]</ref> and [[TIE series|TIE ships]], with some Dawn members also boarding the [[Amaxine Space Station]] to try and hold back [[Darth Sidious]], [[Darth]] Vader,<ref name="Hidden Empire 4" /> and their escort<ref name="Hidden Empire 5">[[Hidden Empire 5|''Hidden Empire'' 5]]</ref> of [[death trooper]]s and [[Emperor's Royal Guard]]s.<ref name="Hidden Empire 4" /> In the end, however, the Dawn forces would be defeated and suffer causalities.<ref name="Hidden Empire 5" />

===New Republic Era===
During the later stages of the war between the Rebel Alliance and the Empire, the Alliance transformed into the [[New Republic]].<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref> Togruta continued to serve in the New Republic during the war, with the Togruta [[Auxi Kray Korbin]] serving as an [[advisor]] to [[Chancellor (New Republic)|New Republic Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]].<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref>

==Equipment==
[[File:ShaakTi-SWBC60.png|thumb|right|250px|Shaak Ti, a Togruta, wore flowing Jedi robes with a dark yellow sash.]]
A garnet bandeau and skirt was worn by Padawan Ahsoka Tano at the start of the Clone Wars, along with white leggings, high boots, long gloves of the same color, and a sash. Later, Tano began wearing a tunic that revealed her back, along with grey leggings, armbands, and the same Togruta sash.<ref name="TCW" />

Shaak Ti, another Togruta Jedi, spent most of her time wearing flowing Jedi robes with a dark yellow sash that hung from her waist.<ref name="Episode II" />

Gupat Roshti, leader of planet Kiros during the Clone Wars, had a long sleeved shirt with white and gold borders decorating it. A purple piece of material was draped on his shoulders; a brown belt was on his hips and violet pants, light purple boots completed the rest of Roshti's outfit.<ref name="Slaves" />

Female Togruta often wore skin-tight clothes that left exposed parts of their bodies, including the waist, back, and arms. Sleeveless tops and tight leggings were common. There was a decorative Togruta sash woven around the hips and high-heeled sandals were worn on the feet.<ref name="TCW" />

Males typically had loose sleeved tops, pants that were baggy around the knees, and high boots. Some had tight belts fastened around their waists.<ref name="TCW">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
